name: Banh canh
summary: Thick noodles of rice flour or bột lọc under roasted pork, fish cake, seafood, and herbs, with green chili and garlic-chili fish sauce on the side.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, calls it a familiar local bowl.
howToEat: The article names toppings of roasted pork, fish cake, herbs, and seafood, and says to add green chili, chili sauce, and garlic-chili fish sauce.
Ask which noodle the pot is using: rice flour or bột lọc.
seoTitle: Banh canh — thick noodles in Hoi An
seoDescription: Bánh canh in Hoi An is rice-flour or bột lọc noodles, with roasted pork, fish cake, herbs, or seafood.
